architecture.mechanism: 200 nm ZrO2 forms a rigid percolation framework that promotes pore closure and improves local sintering, enhancing mechanical integrity against thermal stresses.
architecture.intervention: Incorporate 200 nm ZrO2 particles into the ceramic sealant material to form a percolation framework that resists crack initiation during thermal cycling.
architecture.expected_effect: Delay crack initiation and increase the fatigue life of the solid oxide fuel cell beyond 1000 thermal cycles.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure the critical particle size of ZrO2 using SEM and correlate with sintering behavior; if 200 nm particles do not form a percolation framework or do not extend the sintering stage as predicted, the mechanism is falsified.
